name: security-review
description: Finds exploitable application security vulnerabilities in code changes. Use for Warden security scans, appsec review, OWASP-style checks, authentication or authorization bugs, injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, secrets, unsafe crypto, webhook verification, open redirects, or sensitive data exposure.

findings.excerpt: | Expression injection | Attacker/caller-controlled `${{ }}` reaches `run:`, composite shell steps, `bash -c`, `node -e`, `python -c`, `actions/github-script`,
- `npx semver -i ${{ inputs.bump }} "$CURRENT"`, `gh pr create --fill ${{ inputs.pr_options }}`, `docker build -t ${{ inputs.tag }}`, `git checkout ${{ inputs.r
- Build/test/package commands after PR checkout: `npm install`, `pnpm install`, `npm test`, `pip install`, `tox`, `pytest`, `make`, `cargo`, `go test`, `bundle`
| SSRF | `fetch(req.query.url)`, image/preview/proxy fetchers using user URLs, redirect-following after first-hop validation | Exact host allowlist, private-IP
| Command injection | `os.system`, `subprocess.run(..., shell=True)`, shell strings with request data | `subprocess.run([fixed_binary, fixed_arg])`, strict allo
| SSRF | `requests.get(request.GET["url"])`, preview/proxy fetchers, redirect-following after first-hop validation | Exact host allowlist, block private/link-lo
